title: Average Speed Used Total Distance Over Total Time
text: id: COMP-002 domain: math title: Average Speed Used Total Distance Over Total Time tags: average-speed, rate, time memory: I once averaged two speeds directly and got a smooth wrong answer. The trip log exposed it: speed was distance divided by time, not the average of the speed labels. I computed each leg's time, added the distances, added the times, and divided total distance by total time. The answer felt less tidy but it matched the road.

title: Printer Rate Became Per Printer Per Minute
text: id: COMP-005 domain: math title: Printer Rate Became Per Printer Per Minute tags: rates, printers, unit-rate memory: A printer problem became clear only when I found the per-printer-per-minute rate. Four printers and six minutes made a combined work window, not a single machine. I divided pages by printers and minutes, then rebuilt the new combined rate for the smaller printer group. I wrote the combined rate explicitly as printers times per-printer rate, with pages per minute beside it, before dividing pages by that rate. The final time carried minutes, not pages.

title: Carry Units Through Every Arithmetic Line
text: id: COMP-013 domain: math title: Carry Units Through Every Arithmetic Line tags: units, sanity-check, arithmetic memory: I once had correct arithmetic attached to impossible units. Since then I keep units beside the numbers while I work. Pages per minute, kilometers per hour, dollars, liters, and tickets each have to survive the line they are in. When units break, I know the setup broke before the answer did.

title: Ratio Mixture Counted Total Parts Before Liters
text: id: COMP-009 domain: math title: Ratio Mixture Counted Total Parts Before Liters tags: ratio, mixture, parts memory: A mixture ratio felt like two numbers competing until I counted total parts. Two parts and five parts made seven parts total, and I wrote total volume divided by total parts to find liters per part. Only then did I multiply by each side of the ratio. The concentrate and water added back to the requested total.
